Nora (eng-sre): Postmortem follow-up for Ember On‑Prem isolation. Quick sync: owners, short targets, and recurring patterns to track. I will shepherd until handoff Friday.

Nora (eng-sre): TL;DR Action items:
- Ben: VPC peering route ordering + reconcile backoff (owner) — target: Thu EOD
- Priya: rollback playbook + canary harness (owner) — target: Wed noon
- Ravi: peer-health probe + stale-route alerting (owner) — target: next sprint start
- Tanya: customer comms + test access (owner) — target: Wed afternoon

Ben (eng-platform): Taking the peering fix. Suspect race when on‑prem controller re‑advertises prefixes. Will gather BGP withdraw/announce logs.

Nora (eng-sre): Paste of relevant log window we captured: ``[2024-06-07T03:12:11Z] BGP: withdraw 10.20.0.0/24 -> ember-edge
[2024-06-07T03:12:12Z] RouteTable: reconciling, saw stale entry
[2024-06-07T03:12:14Z] Service: connection resets, increased KV misses``

Priya (eng-runtime): For rollback: I plan a two‑step rollback (primary -> quantized small variant) plus canary gating. Need ephemeral mirrored tenant to avoid data bleed. Tanya — can you provision?

Tanya (prodops): Provisioned ephemeral tenant ember-mirror-48h and granted Priya access token (72h TTL). :white_check_mark:

Ravi (infra): I will add a 2m peer probe and an alert on 3 consecutive failures. Also add detection for route-staleness (withdraw/announce churn). Question: prefer auto-failover after sustained failures or pager-only?

Nora (eng-sre): Start pager-only with a staggered silent rollback candidate. If anomalies persist >15m, failover to regional fallback pool. Document procedure in runbook.

Ben (eng-platform): Opening PR with 10s reconcile backoff and test matrix. Will link here when ready.

Priya (eng-runtime): Canary infra provisioned in ember-mirror-48h. Smoke tests 4/4 green, KV primed. Starting small load step.

incident-bot: Created issue #5040 "ember-onprem-peering-reconcile" and linked to postmortem doc. Assignee: Ben. Due: 2024-06-14.

Nora (eng-sre): Recurring patterns to add to the recurring-incidents board: 1) edge BGP flaps causing transient isolation during heavy writes, 2) route reconciliation races when on‑prem controllers re‑advertise prefixes.

Tanya (prodops): Scheduled customer sync with Ember ops Thu 1600 PST to review runbook and access assumptions.

Ben (eng-platform): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/811 (WIP). Adding reviewers @Priya @Nora.

Priya (eng-runtime): Canary tests completed. Added smoke + priming check into harness.

Ravi (infra): Probe deployed to staging, 2m cadence, alert on 3x failures. Will run a spike test in next 24h.

Nora (eng-sre): Daily close: Ben PR -> review, Priya canary -> green, Ravi probe -> staging, Tanya comms -> scheduled. Next check-in Friday 10:00 PST. Please post one-line updates here when you make progress.
